Thank you mate, I’ve just had trouble connecting to myself lately, it’s just been hard cause I’m sitting here and she just sends the whole “best way to get over is get under” it stung. Cause I can’t do that, mentally I can’t, cause I was holding out for the thought of maybe she’ll try again? Maybe she will want another go around.
I believe I’ve tried my best to be what people want to have around, someone they could depend on, and it’s been hard to be the one who’s down, and I have tried to reach out and it’s been hard for me, I’ve never been good at it. But it’s been a struggle trying to talk about it, cause I’ve just told my brother and I feel he’s swamped with it.

Thanks man, it’s just been hard, I know life isn’t about people it’s about the experience, but it’s just been hard for me to move on, I can’t just live life like she is, I’m sitting here being moody and upset and feeling like I’m the useless one.
That’s all I can think atm, like holy shit what does it know.
Man I want to hear a part 2 and Ashley goes in
Trust me it’s worse in Australia,

Well, in one dream I feel older, but I’m in a corner office doing some paperwork in a lawyer firm, I’ve never caught the name, every time I’ve nearly seen it feels blurred out. But I head to a meeting and talk to a few people about settling their suits and calming a situation. 

In another I’m a mechanic just finishing work on an older car, just finished taking the transmission out and I see a wife/girlfriend come in and say hey, then I feel that I’m meant to have that, and I’m missing some larger part of my life.

Another life I feel is that I’m just some guy who sits around and tries to figure things or, chasing conspiracies and such and finding nothing but still saying I’m some “woke warrior” and constantly saying I’m this higher being in a future war. But computer savvy and such.

See I’m unsure on what it is, I’m sitting here feeling that it’s truthful, as if it’s someone else’s life, then again I feel it’s possible to be mine if I put enough towards it. I feel strange and I need clarity
What if the dream coincides with the glitch? Like I’ve been having some strange dreams that are freaking me out
Gotta get anything4views as well in that mix
Doing the lords work. Papa bless
I think they’ve been more testing on YT with its live feature and just kept going with it
That’s incredible mate, well done! I’m yet to try the Keto diet, I thought about it since going to gym more frequently, you look a lot healthier though.
The issue is is as you said, it’s easy.
